verdict.rationale: Vanta's webhooks deliver real-time HTTP notifications when events happen, with signature verification and retries, so users can trigger actions in their own code (vanta-docs-4). Custom Tests let users define pass/fail rules on pushed data (vanta-docs-2), and Vanta mentions automated reminders and workflows for risk assessments (vanta-docs-22). However, there is no evidence of a native rule builder where users define event-to-action automations inside Vanta; acting on events requires external tooling. Missing for 10: a native user-defined event→action rule engine, documentation of configurable workflow triggers and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
